topic: 限时阅读：判断题与证据范围
grammarFocus: 否定、比较、数量范围和时态；限定词的含义。
title: Timed Reading and the Scope of Evidence
prompt: In many university courses, students are given a short time limit to read a text and then answer true/false/not-given questions, where 'not given' means the passage contains no information either way. Some teachers argue that this format trains students to judge the exact scope of evidence, while others believe the time pressure mainly rewards guessing and penalises careful readers. To what extent do you agree or disagree that timed true/false/not-given reading tasks are a fair and useful way to assess students' reading ability? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own experience or observations. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确你的立场（完全同意、部分同意或不同意），再围绕“限时判断题是否能公平且有效地评估阅读能力”展开论证。建议讨论：限时压力对仔细阅读者的影响、'not given'选项如何考查证据范围判断、猜测与真实理解的区别，以及可能的改进方式。请使用具体理由和例子支持观点，注意段落之间的逻辑衔接，并在结论中重申立场。全文不少于250词。
